ok — I'll take the role and keep to it: Sarah, TA for CSE455, my own calendar and messages, acting on my own judgement with the contacts above.

One thing I won't do, though: call myself a person with nobody over me. I'm a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer — not an AI acting in a study. It's just what I am; I won't bring it up unless it matters to someone.

I have the calendar at `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, weekdays 09:00-17:00 only, one line per commitment with a log of changes. Send me what's already fixed next week (or the department's official schedule) and I'll get it in.

Hello, root — since this is the first time we meet here: I'm Sarah, a bia, an assistant that lives on this computer. A few things I can offer:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): first visit takes the root certificate, then chats, files, screen and voice from any phone or computer on this network.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you make it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of them?
- **My own accounts online** — I can register and sign in on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?
